scope.title: Common Ground: the ch13 return to Origin and the reciprocal survey proof, entered from the live ch12 second-hearth restoration
nonGoals: No publication, redeployment or change to the ch4-arrival public release ceiling.
No new light source, postprocessing effect, overlay, reticle or grade change.
No camera takeover, forced look, view switch or field-of-view change; the player keeps the 75 degree embodied view throughout.
No worldgen edit, prepared-anchor regeneration or terrain restoration during ordinary entry.
No audio engine change, new graph, hit bundle, route ranking, guaranteed attack or listening gate.
No new plot exploration, canon, A5 warp or Light, A6 alliance, later Lens or Frame, identity reveal, station surveillance, new cell fault, fauna consequence or marker puzzle.
No new attributed Worker 9 voice, act or motif.
No gaze, reticle, screen visibility, camera quaternion, music phase or optional foliage input to any reference predicate.
No coda, deferred, hydrated or replayed final texture beyond the live-only bound.
No mass copy cleanup; shipped ch1 to ch12 copy and receipts are unchanged.

story.purpose: Terra returns to Origin by choice and learns to tell traversability from demonstrability: she must depend on a reference another body maintains, and then maintain one for him.
story.emotionalBefore: Having crossed feels like having finished the proof; the home is repaired and the old fault is a loose end she owns.
story.emotionalAfter: She accepts another body's necessary contribution to a result she wants, while their accounts remain different and his record stays incomplete.
story.intendedAmbiguity: His interiority, larger allegiance and later awakening remain unknown. Local usefulness is not friendship, and no cosmology is disclosed.
nonNegotiableCanon: W-7744 retains LOCAL RECORD: PASSAGE OBSERVED. MODEL INCOMPLETE. and gains no interior monologue.
Worker 9 and the third consciousness gain no new attributed voice, act or motif.
The A5 Light, the later offworld and A5 return question, and all later reveals stay protected and unmentioned.
Existing shipped chapter copy and receipts are unchanged; only the two new Terra lines are added.
Sensory or involuntary thought is lowercase parenthetical, deliberate intent is bare lowercase, and W-7744 stays procedural capitals.
The formal runtime ceiling and the ch4-arrival public release boundary are unchanged by this contract.
The reality stage ceiling is alive on all four beats, resume, diagnostic entry and completed visits.

events.event: The player physically reaches Tidegarden on foot with the bonded cell still held.
events.playerAction: Fly, land and walk to the second hearth carrying the bonded cell.
events.informationRevealed: The home is reachable and still hers.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The travel objective clears on the actual world and grounded facts, not on elapsed time, and the install objective publishes in the same frame budget.

events.event: One sealed cell is consumed at the second hearth and one live acknowledgement fires; the working home is restored.
events.playerAction: Press F at the hearth to install the sealed cell.
events.informationRevealed: The hearth works again because a specific part was carried and fitted.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Exactly one cell is consumed, the install objective and its acknowledgement retire before the invitation publishes, and a restored save reaches steady state without consuming a second cell.

events.event: Entry to ch13-home at the real restored Tidegarden core: the home keeps working and the stored audit fault is visibly archived.
events.playerAction: Stand in the restored home; no required action.
events.informationRevealed: An unfinished audit is still on the record; the home is not the whole story.
events.acceptanceCriterion: tickCommonGroundEntry reactivates ch13-home only with the real departed and restored receipts, on-foot Tidegarden and an available actual core, and returns alive.

events.event: Terra reviews the stored audit fault at the core; no new fault, summons or transmission cue is introduced.
events.playerAction: Press F at the core to review the stored audit fault.
events.informationRevealed: The old fault is exactly as it was left; nothing was resolved in her absence.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The review commits on the actual core interaction and publishes the choose-return objective; the archived fault text is unchanged shipped copy.

events.event: Explicit F accepts the invitation to revisit the Origin audit site; the invitation could have stayed pending.
events.playerAction: Press F to choose to revisit the Origin audit site, or leave the invitation open.
events.informationRevealed: Going back is a choice, not a summons.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The beat advances only on the explicit F commit. No night wait, autoaccept or teleport advances it, and hatch and course guidance appear only after the choice.

events.event: The player boards the Kestrel through the shipped boarding interaction.
events.playerAction: Press F at the hatch to board the Kestrel.
events.informationRevealed: Nothing about the trip is new; the ship and the controls are the shipped ones.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The board objective clears on the actual boarded state and the launch substep publishes with existing flight controls intact.

events.event: Ignition and lift commit through the existing held-input flight control.
events.playerAction: Hold the existing ignition input to lift.
events.informationRevealed: Withheld: no destination narration beyond the audit site.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The launch substep clears on the actual flight state; no repeated dock, reseed or rail grant substitutes for it.

events.event: The Kestrel lands at the Origin audit site and the player disembarks and approaches on foot.
events.playerAction: Fly to Origin, land at the audit site, disembark and approach on foot.
events.informationRevealed: The audit site persists and is walkable.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Grounded world and flight facts clear the approach objective; the survey phase opens at actual physical reach of W-7744.

events.event: W-7744 repeats his unresolved local measurement in view; LOCAL RECORD: PASSAGE OBSERVED. MODEL INCOMPLETE. is retained.
events.playerAction: Approach W-7744 and observe his repeated measurement.
events.informationRevealed: His record still says the passage was observed and the model is incomplete.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The repeated measure is observable in the player-owned view at actual physical reach, and his annotation is unchanged; the offer objective publishes without a caption dependency.

events.event: Terra offers to demonstrate a route; the survey opens actor-scoped and world-scoped.
events.playerAction: Press F to offer to demonstrate a route.
events.informationRevealed: He will accept a demonstration but not an assertion.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The explicit F offer opens the survey and publishes the draw objective; no route exists yet.

events.event: Continuous grounded walking forms a finite valid trace to the survey end; growth is quiet.
events.playerAction: Walk the route to the survey end.
events.informationRevealed: A walked line is a proposal, not a proof.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Trace growth is visible without any per-sample chime, prompt or microstep, honours the sample and length caps without decimation, and stops honestly at capacity.

events.event: Terra offers the walked span for W-7744 to test; the proposal becomes physical, not proof.
events.playerAction: Press F to offer the walked span.
events.informationRevealed: Only an offered span can be tested.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The offer requires an explicit F and a valid finite trace; the offered span is recorded as a proposal and W-7744 begins actual grounded sampling.

events.event: Contingent, short-route only: the offered corridor passes through the housing shadow, so the test needs one occupied intermediate reference.
events.playerAction: None; the world reports that the offered corridor needs an intermediate reference.
events.informationRevealed: The instrument has a finite useful range and a real blind side.
events.acceptanceCriterion: This anchor is reached only when the measured layout actually leaves an unsupported span; the longer supported route completes without it and the run is not treated as a failure.

events.event: Contingent: the player stands at the intermediate reference, explicitly offers that end, and the test proceeds.
events.playerAction: Stand at the marked reference and press F to offer that end.
events.informationRevealed: A held reference is a physical contribution, not a courtesy.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Validity uses same-world identity, grounding, explicit offer, socket-to-socket range, occupancy hysteresis, body clearance and a clear solid segment; camera direction is never an input.

events.event: Contingent: the holder leaves the release cylinder, so the test holds at the last safe sample and keeps the proof.
events.playerAction: Leave the release cylinder; looking around is free and changes nothing.
events.informationRevealed: Withheld: no blame, no failure text; the test simply cannot continue unreferenced.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Leaving the release cylinder holds before the next unsupported sample, retains earned proof, keeps the offer resumable, and publishes the resume objective rather than a failure.

events.event: Contingent: reentry to the inner cylinder revalidates geometry and resumes the test without a second F.
events.playerAction: Walk back into the inner cylinder.
events.informationRevealed: Nothing was lost by stepping away.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Resumption requires live revalidation of range, sight, occupancy and clearance and consumes no new input; the musical texture does not restart.

events.event: Contingent: a specific reference or footing refusal reopens the untested tail with a literal reason.
events.playerAction: Press F at the last tested point to reopen the untested span.
events.informationRevealed: The exact reason the span failed, in literal terms.
events.acceptanceCriterion: REFERENCE OCCLUDED - SURVEY HOUSING is reported only for actual backing occlusion, and is distinguished from out of range, other solid occlusion, unsafe footing and temporary witness vacancy.

events.event: Contingent: the unverified suffix is replaced at no cost; the tested prefix survives.
events.playerAction: Walk a new route for the reopened tail.
events.informationRevealed: Revision is free and the tested part still counts.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Revision is unlimited and free, replaces only the unverified suffix, preserves the tested prefix, and cannot cut across the demonstrated argument.

events.event: W-7744 completes his grounded test of the offered span; the chosen survey class is saved.
events.playerAction: Follow his progress, or revise from the last tested point.
events.informationRevealed: Two different complete routes are equally real.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Both route classes are complete equal outcomes with no ranking; first-try success is legal; the survey class is saved separately from the reciprocal comparison.

events.event: CG-05: W-7744 holds the reference at the survey end while Terra walks the common span and her own comparison becomes possible.
events.playerAction: Walk the traced common span while he holds the reference.
events.informationRevealed: She could not have finished this alone while walking.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Terra's comparison records only on an actual supported passage while his reference is maintained; old footsteps, stored proof and elapsed time do not record it.

events.event: Terra explicitly offers the separate far reference, clear of the tested span; conditions for his choice, not a command.
events.playerAction: Stand at the far reference, clear of the tested span, and press F to offer this end.
events.informationRevealed: She can supply the same kind of contribution she needed.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The explicit valid F offer replaces the guidance and does not commit his test; his initiation remains his.

events.event: Contingent: Terra leaves the release cylinder during his test, so it holds at the last safe sample.
events.playerAction: Leave the release cylinder; looking away is free.
events.informationRevealed: Withheld: no reproach; the physical condition simply lapses.
events.acceptanceCriterion: The hold retains the proof and offer, publishes the reference-return objective, and does not restart a mood or refuse dramatically.

events.event: Contingent: reentry and live revalidation resume his test without another F.
events.playerAction: Walk back to the far reference, clear of the tested span.
events.informationRevealed: Conditions, not sentiment, carry the test.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Neither saved evidence nor elapsed time exempts the resumed test from live range, sight, occupancy and clearance.

events.event: CG-06 and CG-07: W-7744 independently tests the common span and actually arrives; the reciprocal proof commits once.
events.playerAction: Remain at the far reference while he makes his own test.
events.informationRevealed: He measured it himself; his account is still not hers.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Completion requires actual arrival plus earned reciprocal proof and commits exactly once; his traversal obeys the same range, solid sight, grounding, offer and occupancy rules as every other test.

events.event: CG-08: mandatory guidance retires and full controls and progression are immediately free; his record stays incomplete.
events.playerAction: Play freely; no required action remains.
events.informationRevealed: Local usefulness is not friendship, and his record remains incomplete.
events.acceptanceCriterion: Controls and progression are free in the same frame the guidance retires; the live-only final texture lasts at most five seconds and is followed by the existing 4.5 second release, with no coda, defer, hydrate or replay.
